title: Senior Oracle Functional Lead - Record to Report
description:
Role Description
 As the Oracle Functional Lead for Record to Report, you will own the design, configuration and evolution of the systems behind how Dropbox records, reconciles, consolidates and reports its financial results. You'll work hands-on across Oracle Fusion General Ledger, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Intercompany and Subledger Accounting, the custom Oracle PaaS applications that automate our close, and the integrations that bring in data from treasury, banking, payroll, expense, lease and revenue systems.
 This is a senior, hands-on role. You'll be the functional DRI for Record to Report: leading design on complex initiatives, configuring Oracle, and partnering with Controllership, Treasury, Tax and FP&A to make the close faster, more automated and better controlled.
 Responsibilities
 Propose and shape the multi-quarter RTR strategy and roadmap in partnership with leadership — where to invest, what to transform, what to retire — and translate it into delivery, using automation and AI to reduce manual work in the close while strengthening SOX controls
 Own Oracle Fusion RTR configuration hands-on across General Ledger, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Intercompany and Subledger Accounting, including period close, journal approvals and bank reconciliation rules
 Own the wider close platform estate — Oracle ARCS for account reconciliation, EDM for master data and hierarchies, and the reporting and planning integrations supporting EPM and statutory reporting
 Direct offshore delivery partners on R2R build and support work
 Design custom integrations into Oracle from treasury, banking, HR and payroll, expense, lease and revenue systems using Oracle Integration Cloud, Workato, REST APIs and file-based FBDI and UCM patterns
 Design and support custom Oracle PaaS solutions that underpin close: automate journals, accruals, reconciliations, foreign currency translation, and intercompany processes .
 Partner with Controllership, Treasury, Tax, FP&A and vendors to…

title: Hardware Program Manager, Lyft Urban Solutions
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Lyft Urban Solutions powers the bike-sharing and scooter-sharing systems that move millions of people in over 60 cities worldwide. We built North America's first automated bike-share system and continue to lead the micromobility revolution. Our systems operate globally - from Citi Bike in New York to BIXI in Montreal, Divvy in Chicago, Capital Bikeshare in DC, and iconic systems in Austin, Barcelona, Bogota, Boston, Buenos Aires, Columbus, Detroit, Dubai, London, Madrid, Mexico City, Monaco, Pittsburgh, Portland, Rio de Janeiro, San Francisco, Toronto, and beyond.
 We're not just technology providers - we operate these systems, building the software, hardware, and operations that make urban micromobility work at scale.
 Ready to shape how millions of people move through their cities every day?
 Manufacturing Program Managers at Lyft drive cross-functional initiatives, leveraging strong leadership, planning, communication, and collaboration skills. Our MPMs are commercially astute and technically strong with manufacturing engineering, factory build, automation or test systems, or facilities construction experience. They focus on ensuring that our Hardware Supply teams have a cohesive cross functional program plan and executes aggressively to this plan. They are problem solvers who make things happen around them by setting clear goals and inspiring teams to deliver.
 MPMs at Lyft are both strategic and tactical and do what it takes to successfully deliver key programs that have a material impact on the business. They are expected to own the project plan, chair associated governance meetings, develop cohesion between teams, solve problems and escalate as required. This will also include picking up and completing project related tasks as may be required.

title: Gestionnaire de Programme Matériel, Lyft Solutions Urbaines
description:
Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir.
 Lyft Urban Solutions gère les systèmes de vélos et de trottinettes en libre-service qui transportent des millions de personnes dans plus de 60 villes à travers le monde. Nous avons créé le premier système de vélos en libre-service automatisé d'Amérique du Nord et restons à la pointe de la révolution de la micromobilité. Nos systèmes sont présents partout dans le monde : de Citi Bike à New York à BIXI à Montréal, en passant par Divvy à Chicago, Capital Bikeshare à Washington D.C., et des systèmes emblématiques à Austin, Barcelone, Bogota, Boston, Buenos Aires, Columbus, Detroit, Dubaï, Londres, Madrid, Mexico, Monaco, Pittsburgh, Portland, Rio de Janeiro, San Francisco, Toronto et bien d'autres villes.
 Nous ne sommes pas de simples fournisseurs de technologies : nous exploitons ces systèmes, en développant les logiciels, le matériel et les opérations qui permettent à la micromobilité urbaine de fonctionner à grande échelle.
 Envie de contribuer à façonner le quotidien de millions de personnes dans leurs villes ?
 Les Gestionnaires de Programmes Matériel chez Lyft pilotent des initiatives transversales, en s'appuyant sur un leadership affirmé, d'excellentes compétences en planification, en communication et en collaboration. Dotés d'un sens aigu des affaires et d'une solide expertise technique, ils possèdent une expérience en ingénierie de fabrication, en construction d'usines, en automatisation, en systèmes d'essai ou en construction d'installations. Leur priorité est de s'assurer que nos équipes d'approvisionnement en matériel disposent d'un plan de programme transversal cohérent et de veiller à sa mise en œuvre rigoureuse. Véritables agents de changement, ils savent mobiliser les équipes en fixant des objectifs clairs et en les inspirant à atteindre leurs objectifs.

title: Social Media Marketing Manager:in (m/w/d) Paid Ads
description:
Remote | Performance Marketing | FIRST STARS
 Über uns
 FIRST STARS ist eine Performance Marketing Agentur , die Unternehmen dabei hilft, durch datengetriebenes Marketing nachhaltig zu wachsen. Wir arbeiten mit ambitionierten Brands – von schnell wachsenden Nischenunternehmen bis hin zu internationalen Marken – und entwickeln skalierbare Paid-Social-Strategien, die echte Ergebnisse liefern.
 Unser Team arbeitet remote, international und mit hohem Anspruch an Qualität und Performance . Wir glauben an Eigenverantwortung, schnelle Lernkurven und daran, dass die besten Ideen aus Teams entstehen, die sich gegenseitig herausfordern und unterstützen.
 Aufgaben
 Deine Rolle
 Als Social Media Manager – Paid Ads übernimmst du Verantwortung für die Performance unserer Kundenkampagnen. Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, unserem Creative-Team und dem Performance-Team zusammen, um Kampagnen zu entwickeln, zu testen und zu skalieren.
 Du bist nicht nur operativ stark – sondern verstehst auch Strategie, Daten und Wachstum.
 Deine Aufgaben
 Strategische Betreuung unserer Kunden im Performance Marketing
 Onboarding neuer Kunden im Paid-Ads-Bereich und Entwicklung einer skalierbaren Kampagnenstrategie
 Planung, Steuerung und Optimierung von Paid-Social-Kampagnen auf Meta (Facebook & Instagram), TikTok und Pinterest
 Entwicklung und Testing von Ad-Creatives gemeinsam mit unserem Inhouse-Design-Team
 Durchführung von Zielgruppen-, Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen
 Analyse von KPIs, Tracking und Attribution , um Kampagnen datenbasiert zu optimieren
 Erstellung von Reportings, Analysen und Präsentationen für unsere Kunden
 Strategische Beratung unserer Kunden zu Wachstum, Skalierung und Kampagnenstruktur
 Mentoring und Unterstützung von Trainees im Paid-Ads-Bereich
 Qualifikation

 du mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Paid Social / Performance Marketing hast
